perimeters.label: Perimeters and companies
perimeters.title: Work perimeters
perimeters.description: The teams and agencies that structure your workspace, and the companies that invoice. Archiving keeps the history.

rules.label: Business rules

expenses.title: Expense scale
expenses.subtitle: What your company reimburses, by category and by client. Expense reports are compared with this scale; a category without a cap is never called compliant.

rules.title: Business rules
rules.description: A few explicit rules, without redoing the work flows.

catalogues.label: Catalogues and vocabulary
catalogues.title: Catalogues & vocabulary
catalogues.description: The reasons you pick and the words your workspace uses.

guardrails.title: Non-negotiable safeguards
guardrails.subtitle: What {{copilot}} and the team never do, whatever the setting. Read-only.

noProtectedCriterion.title: No protected criterion
noProtectedCriterion.description: Age, gender, origin, photo or address never weigh in a person’s rank.

humanCorrectionWins.title: A human correction wins
humanCorrectionWins.description: Whatever its date, it is never overwritten by a collection.

behavior.title: {{copilot}}’s behaviour
behavior.subtitle: The starting point of new conversations. Not a permission to act.

context.label: Context and depth
context.description: These preferences do not change threads that are already open.

depth.label: Default depth
depth.rapideHint: A quick answer, without web search.
depth.approfondiHint: More research and checking: longer and costlier. The cost is announced before each search.

behavior.neutralNote: Neutral removes the implicit preferences of the profile. It does not mean “no data”, nor “private conversation”: the context you provide remains available.

actions.label: Actions and permissions
actions.description: Execution controls are not a simple autonomy slider.

research.title: Research and preparation
research.description: {{copilot}} prepares work within the authorised scope and budget.

sending.title: External sends and writes
sending.description: {{copilot}} never sends: it prepares, you send. A write to your CRM goes through your validation.

sources.label: Sources and memory
sources.description: Documents and personal items remain viewable and removable.

documents.label: Documents and references
documents.title: Documents & references
documents.description: Find the items you allow {{copilot}} to draw on.

hub.title: All your automations, in one place.
hub.description: Describe a follow-up to {{copilot}} or adjust a routine. Settings do not create a second catalogue.

routines.askLauraPrompt: I would like us to set up an automatic follow-up:

watches.title: Account watches
watches.description: Cadences are set closest to the signals, where you follow your accounts.

routines.catalogueCut: Each suggestion can be switched off in

ranges.title: Ranges and targets
ranges.description: Team benchmarks — slots, targets and shared sales capacity — stay those of the Team space.

drawer.title: Routine detail
drawer.description: Configuration, activation conditions and simulation of the routine.

routines.title: Routines & watches
routines.subtitle: One setting for each automation.

import.title: Imports
import.description: Bring in your database, contacts or documents. Nothing is created before the preview.

vivier.title: Talent pool / consultants
vivier.description: CVs or a profile file: the import runs from the talent pool, with its preview.

tool.title: From a connected tool
tool.description: A connector keeps the identity of your tool’s records.

export.title: Export the talent pool
export.description: In ATS format or as a CSV batch.

brand.title: Brand & documents
brand.description: What your colleagues and clients see: name, logo, signature and document footer.
